title: Building Strong Community Connections
description:
Strong communities don’t happen by accident—they’re built through meaningful connection, shared learning, and consistent engagement. Let's explore how user groups, conferences, online forums, and social media groups can work together to create vibrant, supportive, technical communities where people learn all about from one another, build relationships, and grow their impact. Learn practical ideas for fostering connection, encouraging participation, and strengthening community across both in-person and digital spaces.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
